gold.title: Mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. Further this PR removes the float-based right alignment for .d-hea
gold.description: Mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. Further this PR removes the float-based right alignment for .d-header .panel, which may cause the login panel in the non-Ember/noscript header (where .panel is nested inside .row and not a flex item) to stack under the title instead of remaining right-aligned.

candidate.title: Removing float: right from .panel breaks ERB header layout
candidate.description: .row is not a flex container in ERB view, so margin-left: auto and order don't work. Removed float: right was essential for positioning .panel at right edge. Anonymous login button now renders beside logo instead of top-right.

missed_correctness_gold.title: -ms-align-items never existed in any version of IE/Edge; the correct legacy property is -ms-flex-align.
missed_correctness_gold.description: -ms-align-items never existed in any version of IE/Edge; the correct legacy property is -ms-flex-align.

promotion_candidates.title: @include order(2) on .extra-info-wrapper is inert — not a flex child
promotion_candidates.description: Component emits anonymous div between .contents and .extra-info-wrapper, making that div the flex item instead. order/flex sizing on .extra-info-wrapper don't apply, causing long titles to push .panel past .wrap instead of ellipsizing.

promotion_candidates.title: .small-action-desc padding change orphans mobile overrides
promotion_candidates.description: Padding change from 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em to 0 1.5% drops left padding, but mobile override .custom-message { margin-left: -40px } still applies, causing custom messages to hang left and overlap .topic-avatar.

promotion_candidates.title: .small-action flex container lacks sizing for .small-action-desc
promotion_candidates.description: .small-action-desc gets no flex value, defaults to flex: 0 1 auto, shrinks to max-content. Delete/edit buttons hug description text instead of right edge. float: left on .topic-avatar is inert in flex context.
